name: Washer and dryer, stacked, front-loading, 27"
description: Front-loading washer with a dryer stacked above it, 27" wide, 30" deep, about 66" tall, each with a round glass door and its own controls. Washer needs hot and cold supply and a 2" standpipe; the dryer needs a 4" vent outdoors. Leave 24" in front.

params.remarks: Common nominal size, not any maker's product; check the chosen unit's spec sheet.
